source.question: When was well F-11 B completed, and how does its completion report's timing compare with when it started producing?

note: Fair: chart dates cited without the look_at_page evidence that read them; calculations on Unix timestamps the model typed.

submission.summary: Well F-11 B was completed on 2013-07-21 with first oil 3 days later on 2013-07-24, while its Final Well Report (Valid from 2013-09-04) was issued 42 days after production started.

findings.claim: Well F-11 B completion operations finished with perforation ending on 2013-07-21, after Run Completion from 2013-06-30 to 2013-07-04.
findings.detail: Operational Sections table: Run Completion 30.Jun.2013 14:15 to 04.Jul.2013 20:00 MÆRSK INSPIRER; Install Tubing Hanger 04.Jul.2013 20:00 to 06.Jul.2013 12:30; Install X-mas Tree 06.Jul.2013 12:30 to 09.Jul.2013 00:45; Perforation 09.Jul.2013 00:45 to 21.Jul.2013 23:00. Report issued as Final Well Report, Completion, 15/9-F-11 B valid from 2013-09-04.

findings.claim: Well F-11 started producing on 2013-07-24, 3 days after completion finished.
findings.detail: list_wells first_oil for F-11 is 2013-07-24; daily production shows 0.0 on 2013-07-21 to 2013-07-23 then 17.85 Sm3 on 2013-07-24; interval from 2013-07-21 23:00 completion end to 2013-07-24 is 3.0 days.

findings.claim: The completion report was issued on 2013-09-04, 42 days after first oil.
findings.detail: Document issued 2013-09-04 (Valid from Rev. no. 2013-09-04 1:00) and first oil 2013-07-24 = 42.0 days difference.
